issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the total-students accessor: the problem statement text (task description) refers to the method as get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case) while the UML, the template TODO and the solution use the Java-style camelCase name getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This difference (snake_case vs camelCase) appears in the exercise description and may lead students to implement the wrong identifier, causing confusion or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across materials. Update the textual task description in problem_statement.md to use the camelCase name getTotalNumberOfStudents() to match the UML, template TODO, and the provided solution (preferred for Java). Alternatively, if snake_case was intentionally desired (not recommended for Java), update the UML, template, and solution to the same snake_case name and add a note explaining the deviation from typical Java naming conventions.
